name: Basic Rope Jump
setup: Stand tall on the balls of the feet, rope behind you, hands at the hips.
cues: Turn the rope with small circles from the handles, not big arm swings.
Tiny, quiet hops off the floor, an inch high.
Find a steady rhythm, like a metronome beat.

faults.fix: Jump just high enough to clear the rope, quiet on the floor.
Keep the handles by your pockets and turn from them.

name: Bike Sprint Intervals
setup: Set the machine up to fit you and warm up for five easy minutes first.
cues: Hit the same effort every interval, start to finish.
Breathe out long through the easy parts.
Stay smooth: the same tempo at the end as at the start.

faults.fault: First interval flat out, the rest fading
faults.fix: Pick an effort you can repeat for every interval.
Shorten the effort or slow the tempo until it stays smooth.

name: 90/90 Breathing
setup: On your back with the feet flat on a wall, knees and hips bent to right angles.
cues: Press the heels gently into the wall and breathe out until the ribs settle toward the floor.
Breathe in through the nose for a slow count of four.
Let the air out longer than it came in.

faults.fix: Slow the count: four in, six to eight out.

faults.fault: Lifting the shoulders to breathe in
faults.fix: Let the breath widen the ribs toward the walls, not the ears.
